title: Search-Eval Custom Dataset
description: A single homogeneous relation-type dataset the operator brings to augment or replace the 5 default query families. One type per file. built_from is prose describing how it was constructed and drives the per-term source label. Demand (monthly_volume) is carried inline so impact-dollars need no full-set Keyword Planner pass. Type-specific record requirements (counterpart for relational, expected for one_to_one) are enforced by load-custom-dataset.mjs.

type.description: The relation of each record's term to its counterpart/expected. synonym: term == counterpart (counts ~same). hyponym: term narrower than counterpart (term results subset; count <=). hypernym: term broader (superset; count >=). one_to_one: term maps to exactly one expected product (retrieval check).

label.description: Optional short chip label. If absent, load-custom-dataset derives one from type; built_from is always the tooltip.

expected.description: Required for one_to_one. The single product the term should retrieve.
